title: National Flood Map: return-period flood extents for US watersheds
description: Modeled inundation extents for the 2-, 5-, 10-, 25-, 50- and 100-year floods (and 500-year where the LP-III method was used) for US HUC8 watersheds, from NOAA OWP HAND terrain and rating curves driven by National Water Model return-period discharge, plus per-reach discharge and flooded-area statistics.
citation: Harrison Stewart (2026). National Flood Map: return-period flood extents for US watersheds (version 1.0.0) [Data set]. https://theonlyrealagentp.github.io/national-flood-map/
disclaimer: Research product. Not a FEMA Flood Insurance Rate Map; not for insurance, permitting, property or emergency decisions. Extents only (no depth). Levees, culverts, dams and local studies are not represented.

status_meanings.dry: HAND exists and the run completed, but no return-period discharge was available (CIROH covers the lower 48 only); rasters are empty
status_meanings.notrun: NOAA HAND exists but the watershed was not run (Ontario)
status_meanings.nohand: no NOAA HAND for this watershed (open water, Canada, Mexico, most of Alaska and the Pacific)

sources.hand: NOAA Office of Water Prediction HAND FIM inputs, public CIROH bucket s3://ciroh-owp-hand-fim/
sources.fim_engine: FIMserv (https://github.com/sdmlua/FIMserv) wrapping the OWP inundation-mapping engine
sources.discharge_ciroh: CIROH NWM return-period flows API (2-100 yr); reaches it does not cover are absent from the extent
sources.discharge_lp3: Log-Pearson Type III fit to annual peaks of the NWM v3.0 retrospective (1979-2023), 2-500 yr
sources.streams: NWM v3 channel network (nwm_subset_streams from the HAND inputs)
sources.names: NHDPlus V2 value-added attributes (gnis_name, drainage area, reach code), joined on COMID = NWM feature_id (lower 48)
sources.basemap: OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap), USGS The National Map imagery and shaded relief

files.flood.pmtiles: raster PMTiles z0-14, 256 px 8-bit grayscale PNG; value = return-period bit mask; 0 = dry. z14 = 9.554 m source pixels; lower zooms are the bitwise OR of 2x2 pixels
files.streams.pmtiles: vector PMTiles z3-12 (overzoomable), layer 'streams'; order bands appear at z3 (order 7+), z6 (5-6), z8 (3-4), z10 (1-2)
files.cogs/<huc8>.tif: per-watershed Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, EPSG:3857 9.554 m, same bit mask, with a color table

encoding.example: value 62 = bits 1-5 = flooded at 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 years but not at 2 years
encoding.crs: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator); source rasters were EPSG:5070 at 10 m, resampled nearest-neighbour
encoding.seams: where two watersheds overlap, the bit masks are OR-ed (wet if either side is wet)
encoding.nesting: extents for longer return periods normally contain shorter ones; where they do not (mostly LP-III runs) each period is kept exactly as modeled

Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.feature_id (id): NWM v3 reach ID; equals the NHDPlus V2 COMID in the lower 48
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.name (n): GNIS name from NHDPlus V2; blank if none
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.huc8 (h): HUC8 watershed the reach was mapped in
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.drainage_km2 (da): total upstream drainage area, km² (NHDPlus V2)
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.gage (g): USGS gage ID on the reach, if any
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.lake (lk): reach is a lake/reservoir reach in NWM
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.q<T>yr_cms (q<T>): peak discharge for the T-year return period, m³/s
Reach table (CSV) and stream popups.flooded<T>yr_km2 (a<T>): area flooded at the T-year return period inside the reach's NWM catchment, km² (true area, computed on the 9.554 m grid)

Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).st / states: states or countries the watershed touches
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).s / status: mapped, dry, notrun or nohand (see coverage.status_meanings)
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).m / method: CIROH, LP-III or Hybrid (LP-III with CIROH values preferred where present)
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).w / flooded_<T>yr_km2: total area flooded at each return period, km²
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).cov / ciroh_coverage_pct: share of the watershed's reaches CIROH had flows for
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).r, km, nm, g: reach count, stream length (km), named reaches, reaches with a USGS gage
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).nb: pixels wet at a shorter return period but dry at a longer one
Watershed catalog (catalog.json / CSV).b: bounding box, WGS84 [west, south, east, north]
